jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! German language skills are a plus.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.Required professional knowledge and personal skills:• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.• Independent, jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Project Manager of the PUNCH4NFDI Consortium in the NFDILimited: 31.12.2028 | Starting date: 01.01.2027 | ID: FHMA031/2026 | Deadline: 03.12.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possibleDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The PUNCH4NFDI consortium aims at a sustainable utilisation of research data and the establishment of FAIR and open science for particle physics, astroparticle physics, astronomy, and hadron&nuclear physics. The consortium is part of the German national research data infrastructure (Nationale Forschungsdaten­infrastruktur, NFDI) and supported by around 35 institutions - university institutes, Max Planck institutes, Helmholtz centres, as well as Leibniz institutes. As project manager of PUNCH4NFDI, you are a central point of coordination. You oversee the execution of the consortium's work plan and build bridges to other consortia in the NFDI. You organise the internal procedures of the consortium, and you support the spokesperson of the consortium in technical and administrative matters, with the assistance of a project office at DESY. An important part of your work is in supporting the transition of the consortium into a new NFDI structure foreseen to become effective in 2029.About your role:- Coordination of scientific and technical work in PUNCH4NFDI- Coordination of PUNCH4NFDI administration (funding, reporting)- Communication and networking within PUNCH4NFDI and with its partners and stakeholders- Supporting the transition into the post-2028 era of the NFDI- Preparation of PUNCH4NFDI meetingsAbout you:- Ph.D. or equivalent qualification in one of the scientific disciplines of PUNCH4NFDI (particle physics, astroparticle physics, astronomy, and hadron&nuclear physics)- Experience or proven interest in project management, preferably in science- Excellent networking and communication skills- Good mastering of written and spoken German and English- Good team working ability- Experience or proven interest in scientific computing or data management is a plus- Interest in science communicationGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.For further information please contact Dr. Thomas Schörner, +49 40 8998-3429 (https://tel:+494089983429) , thomas.schoerner@desy.de (thomas.schoerner@desy.de)Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:Apply now! jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global SAP P58 Template & Operations team as Senior IT Consultant (f/m/d) SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).The SAP P58 RAR team is responsible for ensuring accurate revenue recognition and revenue reporting in accordance with IFRS 15 and local accounting standards (Local GAAP). As a Senior SAP P58 RAR Consultant, you will work alongside a highly skilled team of SAP RAR consultants and specialists. You will design and implement changes and projects, manage external service providers, support operational activities, and drive international country rollouts within the SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) and Optimized Contract Management (OCM) environmentChoose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You will ensure the stable operation of SAP RAR and SAP OCM applications for business users, as well as accurate revenue reporting and timely month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.* You will represent the team in regular meetings and in the monthly SAP P58 Template & Operations Town Hall.* You will coordinate closely with SAP P58 Application and Functional Leads to advance integration topics. In addition, you will collaborate with the P58 AMS Lead on escalation management and advise the P58 Template Governance as well as business departments on new requirements, changes, and projects.* You will take ownership of the high-quality end-to-end delivery of changes and projects in the SAP RAR and SAP OCM environment, including design, configuration, and integration with additional SAP modules and systems.* You will drive SAP RAR and OCM implementations as the responsible consultant within ongoing international P58 country rollout projects.* You will manage stakeholders and projects, including planning, risk assessment, and risk mitigation.* You will ensure that external service providers deliver agreed services and monitor their performance based on defined KPIs.* You will ensure audit and compliance adherence in line with regulatory, internal, and industry-specific requirements, including IFRS 15 and ASC 606.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-servicesYour qualifications and experience:* You have successfully completed a degree in Business Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a comparable field. Relevant SAP certifications are an advantage.* You have many years of professional experience in the IT environment with a focus on SAP RAR and SAP OCM as well as related SAP modules.* In addition, you bring in-depth expertise in the end-to-end implementation of RAR/OCM solutions and in solution design across related modules. Experience with BRF+ is an advantage.* You also have proven experience in IT project management.* Furthermore, you have a very good understanding of financial processes and the standards IFRS 15 and ASC 606.* You have profound knowledge of IT Service Management as well as ITIL V3/V4, IT Quality, and Compliance.* In addition, you have comprehensive knowledge of the ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 standards as well as the regulatory requirements for non-product software in a global healthcare company.Your attributes and skills:* As you will work with different business units, functions, and regions, you have business-fluent English language skills, both written and spoken.* You stand out through strong analytical skills and excellent problem-solving abilities.* You bring very good communication and presentation skills as well as solid consulting expertise. You find it easy to collaborate with different stakeholders.* You possess strong change management and project management competencies. You are able to efficiently manage multiple projects and support requests in parallel.* You are committed, proactive, and passionate about contributing to the success of Siemens Healthineers.* International business travel is a welcome opportunity for you to support local key users and accompany operational SAP activities on site (approximately 5-10% travel activity).Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/enAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.
